  Zevlor triggers, copying Peer into the Abyss for each opponent.
  Resolve each Peer into the Abyss, causing each opponent to lose half their life total, rounded up, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.

  When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
  At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
  When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
  When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
  Repeat each combat phase.

## Combo 465-3991-4846
Cards: Worldgorger Dragon + Wormfang Drake + Faceless Butcher
Color identity: UBR | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 7 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
Produces: Infinite mana lands you control can produce; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite blinking of permanents
Start: Worldgorger Dragon (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Wormfang Drake (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield); Faceless Butcher (hand, battlefield, exile: Exiled by the creature on the battlefield)
Prerequisites: Faceless Butcher must be exiled by Wormfang Drake, and Worldgorger Dragon must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
Steps: Cast Worldgorger Dragon for its mana cost.
  When Worldgorger Dragon enters, it exiles Wormfang Drake until Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Worldgorger Dragon's ETB.
  When Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, Faceless Butcher is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Faceless Butcher enters, it exiles Worldgorger Dragon until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Faceless Butcher's ETB.
  When Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield, Wormfang Drake is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  When Wormfang Drake enters, it exiles Faceless Butcher until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Wormfang Drake's ETB.
  When Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield, Worldgorger Dragon is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: Due to differences in card templating between the various banisher effects (linked triggered abilities vs "until" clause), steps 3, 5, and 7 may return the creature to the battlefield during the resolution of the preceding step rather than creating a separate event. This should not affect the overall execution of the combo, only how many objects pass through the stack (and thus rounds of priority available per loop).

Steps: Cast Worldgorger Dragon for its mana cost.

  When Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, Worldgorger Dragon is returned from exile to the battlefield.
  Repeat from step 2.
Notes: Due to differences in card templating between the various banisher effects (linked triggered abilities vs "until" clause), steps 3, 5, and 7 may return the creature to the battlefield during the resolution of the preceding step rather than creating a separate event.   If Nicol Bolas has zero loyalty, it dies as a state-based action.
  Resolve the Nicol Bolas ability, creating two token copies of Nicol Bolas that aren't legendary.
  Activate a Nicol Bolas token by putting zero loyalty counter on it, putting a loyalty counters on the other Nicol Bolas token.
  Repeat from step 1 using the second Nicol Bolas token.
Notes: To get infinite turns, activate Jace, Cunning Castaway for an extra turn. Then, use the remaining Nicol Bolas tokens on subsequent turns.

  Each instance of Mishra's Warform's delayed triggered ability triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain half X life, rounded down, for each trigger.

## Combo 1979-3258-4118
Cards: Oriq Loremage + Efreet Flamepainter + Beacon of Tomorrows
Color identity: UBR | Bracket: 4+ (Ruthless) | Popularity: 0 | Commander: legal | Mana needed: {6}{U}{U} on each extra turn
Produces: Infinite turns; Lock
Start: Oriq Loremage (battlefield); Efreet Flamepainter (battlefield); Beacon of Tomorrows (library)
Prerequisites: None of the involved permanents have summoning sickness.
  An opponent is unable to block and kill Efreet Flamepainter.
Steps: Activate Oriq Loremage by tapping it, searching your library for Beacon of Tomorrows, putting it into your graveyard, and putting a +1/+1 counter on Oriq Loremage.
  Deal combat damage to an opponent with Efreet Flamepainter.
  Efreet Flamepainter triggers, causing you to cast Beacon of Tomorrows from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
  Resolve Becaon of Tomorrows, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Beacon of Tomorrows into your library.
  Move to your next turn.
  If you did not draw Beacon of Tomorrows, repeat from step 1.
  Otherwise, cast Beacon of Tomorrows by paying {6}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Beacon of Tomorrows into your library.
  Repeat from step 5.
